_comment: Multi-model registry for mission-driven routing. Pass with --model-registry <path> and --mission on. The router (routeModel) picks the cheapest model whose capabilities meet the mission's needs; a trivial goal routes to the SMALL/FAST model, a complex one to the STRONG model. The gateway starts on 'preferred'. No API keys here — a cloud entry would name an env var via apiKeyEnv. All three below are local Ollama models.
